method: Six poses generated together as one horizontal strip, then sliced, cleaned and normalized to transparent 256x256 frames.
assumptions: Six frames per move. Right-facing three-quarter view throughout.
One uniform resize factor per animation; modest pose-dependent silhouette height variation is preserved.
A gentle grounded side step with no hop; frame 6 settles toward frame 1.
post_processing: System.Drawing: equal-width strip cells, remove detached alpha specks and adjacent-cell fragments, preserve generated transparency, one uniform bicubic scale per animation, centered transparent 256x256 canvases with lowest visible pixel at y=244. Alpha below 12 cleared, alpha at least 245 made opaque. See review.json for exact bounds and checks.

animations.prompt:
Draw a short looping sprite animation of DeepSeek-Chan by ZipZipPipe from the attached reference,
as a cute moe chibi about 2.5 heads tall, clean anime line art with soft cel shading.
Match the attached idle frame exactly: same face, hair, outfit, colours, and size.
Image 1 original character reference; image 2 approved chibi idle frame, PRIMARY reference for exact proportions, rendering and scale.

Move: a small in-place side-step dance with hands up and a happy face; feet stay on the ground line; whale tail visible as in her idle frames. Must loop smoothly.
It plays while she is idle, so it starts and ends close to a calm standing pose.

Make 6 frames as ONE horizontal strip of equal square cells, in order, left to right.
Facing right, three-quarter view. Feet stay on the same ground line in every cell; no hopping.
Same character scale in every cell.
Transparent background.
No text, speech bubbles, question marks, badges, UI, shadows on the ground, or scenery.
Modest outfit.
Identity: long wavy navy hair fading to bright blue ends, curved ahoge, big blue eyes, white frilly maid headband, navy whale-fin ears with white undersides and light-blue bows. Navy maid dress, white frilly apron showing a small blue whale emblem, white frilly socks, navy Mary Jane shoes, navy horizontal whale tail fluke behind toward image LEFT, fully visible each frame.

Make a subtle cyclic dance: 1 centered near-calm stand, happy small smile, hands loosely raised at chest; 2 small side step toward image right, hands raised to shoulder level, bright happy open smile; 3 weight shifts right, hands gently sway right, feet both on baseline; 4 return centered, eyes happily closed, hands shoulder height; 5 tiny side step left, hands sway left, happy smile; 6 weight returning toward center, small smile, hands lowering toward chest, nearly same silhouette and face as frame 1. Seamless 6-to-1 transition, movements only a few pixels at final 256px size. No vertical bouncing or big tilts. Head height varies by at most 2%. No arms or hands above crown.
CRITICAL SPACING: EXACTLY SIX complete small figures in ONE horizontal row, six equal virtual square cells. Prefer 3072x512 (6:1). If output is 3:1, top 28% and bottom 28% entirely transparent: each figure only 44% of full canvas height. Every entire silhouette including all hair and whale tail at most 11% of total canvas width. Centers x=8.33%,25%,41.67%,58.33%,75%,91.67%. Generous transparent gaps. No touching or overlapping neighboring drawings, no clipped hair, no borders or labels, no floating symbols, music notes or sparkles.
